results.expected: a live generation; the guard reports ok

results.expected: ship rejected at bundle; / still serves the same generation

results.name: data the server stores survives a new generation and a rollback
results.expected: a note written now is still there at the end

results.name: a good change goes live and renders in the browser
results.expected: ship live; / serves the new generation; the page shows the change

results.name: a page that crashes in the browser is rolled back by the kernel on its own
results.expected: ship live (the server gate cannot see it); the first browser load reports a crash; live returns to the last good generation

results.name: rolling back makes the seed live again and resets the draft to match
results.expected: live is the seed; / serves it; the draft has the original title; the note is still there

results.name: another person gets their own app, untouched by everything above
results.expected: B grows their own first generation from the seed; B sees none of A's generations, files, or notes; A is unchanged
